annotations.title: Why an Apple Ads creative or brand was rejected

description: WHY an Apple Ads creative, custom product page or Maps brand was REJECTED: Apple’s reason code, type and level (default or custom product page, or a locale of one), the asset or product page it applies to, the country and language, and Apple’s comment — read live. Use it whenever list_apple_ads_creatives shows systemStatus INVALID, or the user asks why an Apple ad is not running. Pass adamId for an app’s reasons, mapsBrandId for a Maps brand’s policy reasons, or rejectionReasonId for one reason. Read-only, free.

adamId.description: the app’s App Store id — every reason Apple holds for it

limit.description: maximum number of reasons to return

mapsBrandId.description: a Maps brand id (list_apple_ads_brands) — its policy rejection reasons. Not `brandId`: over the REST API that name means a Hermoso brand

name: apple_ads_rejection_reasons
title: Why an Apple Ads creative or brand was rejected
